description: This file defines the SigmaTheme class which provides theming configurations for a Flutter application, including color schemes, text styles, and widget themes. It primarily constructs a ThemeData object based on input hex color strings.

classes.name: SigmaTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to build and customize themes for the app.

methods.name: buildTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with specified accent and neon secondary colors, defining overall app styling.

methods.name: _textTheme
methods.description: Private static method generating a TextTheme based on the provided ColorScheme, defining font sizes, weights, and colors for various text styles.
